# BROSKI – Full Brand & Product Documentation

> Official reference for BROSKI dog biscuits, packed in Nangloi, West Delhi – 110041. Treats for your best bro.

## 1. Brand Identity & Entity Details
- **Brand Name:** BROSKI
- **Founder:** Lakshay
- **Entity Type:** Sole Proprietorship
- **Registered Base:** Nangloi, West Delhi – 110041
- **Udyam Registration:** UDYAM-DL-11-0177908
- **Official Website:** https://broskipetfood.com/
- **Support Email:** support@broskipetfood.com
- **Customer Channel:** Direct WhatsApp chat and partner pet shops in West Delhi.

## 2. Active Products & Pricing
### Bro Bites – Classic Crunch
- **Pack Details:** Yellow stand-up zip pouch (400 g net weight).
- **Price:** MRP ₹149 (inclusive of all taxes). Unit price: ₹0.37/g.
- **Description:** Crunchy bone-shaped dog biscuits for training and treat time.
- **Ingredients:** Real Chicken, Egg Powder, Whole Wheat Flour, Rice Flour, Corn Flour, Fish Oil, Vegetable Oil, Sodium Bicarbonate, Flavours, Permitted Colours. Contains chicken and egg.

### Bro Mix – Happy Mix
- **Pack Details:** White stand-up zip pouch (400 g net weight).
- **Price:** MRP ₹179 (inclusive of all taxes). Unit price: ₹0.45/g.
- **Description:** Crunchy dog biscuits for training and treat time.
- **Ingredients:** Chicken Powder, Egg Powder, Whole Wheat Flour, Rice Flour, Corn Flour, Fish Oil, Vegetable Oil, Sodium Bicarbonate, Flavours, Colour. Contains chicken and egg.

### Bro Combo
- **Pack Details:** 2 × 400 g pouches (1 Bro Bites – Classic Crunch + 1 Bro Mix – Happy Mix, 800 g total).
- **Price:** ₹295 (10% off on MRP).

### Complimentary 50 g Taste Pack
- **Pack Details:** 50 g taste pack pouch.
- **Availability:** Free sample reservations via https://broskipetfood.com/sample/ or local tasting drops.

## 3. Feeding Guidelines & Safety
- **Intended Use:** Complementary pet food. A treat, not a complete meal.
- **Feeding Suggestion:** Break into smaller pieces for small dogs.
- **Water:** Always keep fresh water nearby.
- **Shelf Life:** Best before 12 months from packing (see individual pack for batch code and packing date).

## 4. Ordering, Payment & Delivery
- **How to Order:** Tap "Order on WhatsApp" on https://broskipetfood.com/ or email support@broskipetfood.com.
- **Confirmation:** Product selection, delivery day, and payment details are confirmed directly in the WhatsApp chat.
- **Delivery Coverage:** West Delhi.
- **Delivery Charges:** Free delivery within 5 km of Nangloi on orders from ₹295; otherwise applicable delivery charges apply (shown at checkout).

## 5. Pet Shops & Trade Partners
- Pet stores, grooming salons, and veterinary clinics in West Delhi can contact us directly on WhatsApp for wholesale trade terms and complimentary counter tasting jars.
